comment: KYC / CDD reviews (brief 5.6): one row per review - Onboarding (risk assessment at onboarding), Periodic (cadence by KYC risk: High every year, Medium every 2 years, Low every 3 years) or Trigger (event-driven) - due from Apr-2023 to Mar-2027, with due and completed dates, status at 30-Sep-2026 (Completed, Overdue, Due Soon, Scheduled), overdue days, lateness on completion, risk rating before / after the review and the client's current KYC risk rating (High / Medium / Low, from the KYC master). Review status is as of today; for overdue trends by month-end use fact_kyc_review_snapshot_monthly. Periodic reviews scheduled beyond Mar-2027 are not included. Grain: one row per KYC review.
